name: Ankara
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the Ankara metropolitan area (Turkiye), Turkey's capital, covering the nine core metropolitan districts from Esenboga Airport to Golbasi. 285,900+ OSM buildings, 2.85M+ commuters built from TUIK population data by district with jobs estimated from OpenStreetMap commercial density. Special demand points: Esenboga International Airport (real 2025 traffic), Ankara Gari (YHT high-speed rail hub), five university campuses (Ankara University, METU/ODTU, Hacettepe), Anitkabir, Museum of Anatolian Civilizations, and two major industrial zones (OSTIM, ASO 1st OIZ). Simulated traffic congestion on longer commutes.
